patterns.note: A distinct 'hero transition' layout where a full-bleed video gives way to a minimal black section, then a content-focused grid, all within a largely centered content column.
Consistent use of a classic serif font for primary content and headings, contrasted with a clean, minimal sans-serif for navigation and metadata.
A high-contrast black and white palette forms the base, with rich, naturalistic photography providing the primary visual interest and color accents.

A multi-stage sticky header that transforms from an overlay on a video hero to a prominent, centered navigation on a black background, and finally to a standard top-sticky navigation with a white background.
Content sections (text blocks, image grids) reveal with a subtle slide-up or fade-in effect as they enter the viewport.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a full-bleed video that transitions out on scroll, revealing a temporary, minimal black section with a centered navigation before the main content appears.

A sticky header system that evolves: initially transparent and overlaid on the video hero, it then becomes a centered, black-background navigation, and finally a standard top-aligned navigation with a white background and black text, maintaining its position throughout the scroll.
Content sections are revealed using a scroll-triggered animation, where elements slide up or fade in from the bottom as they become visible in the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: A refined, editorial type scale featuring a classic serif for headings and body text, with headings being moderately larger (~1.5-2x body) and a clean sans-serif for small, often uppercase, labels and navigation.
design_tokens.spacing: An airy and balanced spacing rhythm, particularly in the hero and main text blocks, transitioning to a more balanced density within image grids, emphasizing visual breathing room.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a high-quality, artistic video hero that dramatically transitions into a stark, minimal black section before revealing an editorial-style content grid. This creates a strong sense of curated artistry and a unique, almost cinematic, browsing experience that elevates the content itself.
